title: ubuntu-meta (1.481.5) jammy; urgency=medium
description: This completes the work to make the images of Jammy compatible with Noble (and later) for the WSL platform, by including the 'wsl-pro-service' package into the recommended list of packages for the image, done by './update'ing the 'ubuntu-meta' source package to reflect the inclusion of 'wsl-pro-service' package into the jammy seeed. That allows focal images to be managed with Ubuntu Pro for WSL from the first boot.
commit_message:
ubuntu-meta (1.481.5) jammy; urgency=medium

  * Refreshed dependencies
  * Added wsl-pro-service to wsl-recommends [amd64 arm64] (LP: #2136341)
